title: MCP++ A2A Extension Common Primitives@1
description: Shared primitives for the MCP++ A2A execution extension (A2AExtensionSchema@1). Wire URI is https://mcplusplus.io/extensions/execution/v1. Normative prose: ipfs_accelerate_py/mcplusplus/docs/spec/a2a-extension.md. ADR-0006; MCPP-010; MCPP-055.
$comment: Interface label: A2AExtensionSchema@1. Reverse-DNS alias io.mcplusplus.execution@1 is non-wire only.

extensionUri.description: Mandatory wire / Agent Card / A2A-Extensions identifier for the MCP++ execution extension.

metadataKeyPrefix.description: Namespace prefix for extension-defined metadata keys on A2A Task, Message, Artifact, and Skill objects.

workingAlias.description: Human/internal alias only. MUST NOT appear as AgentExtension.uri or as an A2A-Extensions entry.

cid.description: IPFS CID. CIDv1 base32 (b…) preferred for new mints; CIDv0 (Qm…) remains readable when historical.

profileLetter.description: Closed MCP++ profile letter set. Unknown letters are unsupported and fail closed.

profileLetters.description: Ordered set of MCP++ profile letters advertised or requested under the extension.

mcpBindingIds.description: MCP bindings offered by the agent under this extension.

canonicalizationId.description: Canonicalization algorithm id for content-addressed MCP++ objects.

taskState.description: Official A2A TaskState vocabulary (snake_case JSON form). Extensions MUST NOT invent additional public status names.

metadataSuffix.description: Allowed short suffixes under the extension metadata namespace.
